mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 31 degrees and clear at Verona Community Park, and we have a lovely full moon out tonight.

Please note that city buildings will be closed for the Thanksgiving holiday on November 26 and 27. The Verona Recycling Center will also be closed those days, and Thursday refuse and recycling collection will be pushed to Friday, November 27.

We have a busy schedule ahead, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, or Paddy Mac's, plus live music at Paddy Mac's and pizza at Lake Lou-ee. Looking forward, don't miss Thursday's trivia at The Bogey Factory, Thursday night events at ART House 360, live music at Bailey's Run, and a 50th-anniversary craft beer celebration at Wisconsin Brewing Company on Thursday.
In a noteworthy call from November 2, officers responded to a domestic disturbance in the 100 block of West End Circle, resulting in an arrest for battery and disorderly conduct.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Butter Pecan. If you are looking to stop by for a scoop, the store opens today at 10:00 AM.
